intro.en: Encapsulate is en- plus capsule, from Latin capsula, a small box, diminutive of capsa; to encapsulate is to put a thing into a little box that holds it whole.
intro.cn: encapsulate 由 en- 加 capsule 组成，capsule 来自拉丁语 capsula（小盒子），是 capsa 的指小形式；encapsulate 就是把东西放进一个能完整装下它的小盒子里。

items.en: Capsa means a box or a case, especially one for scrolls.
items.cn: capsa 意为盒子、箱子，尤指装卷轴的箱子。

items.en: Capsula is the diminutive, a small box, and gives capsule.
items.cn: capsula 是指小形式，意为小盒子，给出 capsule。

items.en: English uses capsule for a small case holding a dose of medicine.
items.cn: 英语用 capsule 指装一剂药的小壳。

items.en: The verb encapsulate appears for enclosing in a capsule.
items.cn: 动词 encapsulate 出现，指用胶囊封住。

items.en: Computing uses encapsulation for wrapping data with its methods.
items.cn: 计算机领域用 encapsulation 指把数据与它的方法包在一起。

items.en: Criticism extends encapsulate to summing up a whole in one line.
items.cn: 评论把 encapsulate 扩展到用一行字概括整体。

note.en: Encapsulate, capsule and capsular share Latin capsula, a small box; encapsulation is the noun, and capsule alone already carries the shell image.
note.cn: encapsulate、capsule 与 capsular 共享拉丁语 capsula（小盒子）；encapsulation 是名词，而 capsule 本身就带着外壳的意象。

dict_mnemonic.text: encapsulate ＝ en-（使进入）＋ capsul（小盒子，拉丁 capsula，capsa 的指小形）＋ -ate（动词后缀）＝「装进小盒子里」。名词 capsule 胶囊、太空舱，名词 encapsulation 封装、概括，形容词 capsular 囊的。三类用法：装壳 encapsulate a drug 把药物装入胶囊；概括 encapsulate the main points 概括要点、encapsulate an idea 浓缩一个想法、encapsulate in a sentence 用一句话概括；缩影 encapsulate the spirit of 概括…的精神。计算机里 encapsulation 指把数据和方法包在一起。注意 capsule 本身既是胶囊也是密封舱，encapsulate 就是给它加个舱。拼写中间是 -sul- 不是 -sol-。

root: en-（使进入）＋ 拉丁语 capsa（盒子）→ capsula（小盒子）→ capsule（胶囊）→ encapsulate（装入胶囊；概括）

scene: 农场用木栅栏围住羊群。The farm encloses the sheep with a wooden fence.

senses.title: To surround with a boundary
senses.definition: to put a wall, fence, or other boundary around an area
senses.definitionCN: 用墙、栅栏或其他边界把一片区域围起来
senses.example: A fence encloses the garden.
senses.exampleCN: 一道栅栏把花园围了起来。
senses.why: The prefix en- suggests putting something inside, and a boundary keeps it there.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 en- 暗示把某物放入其中，而边界把它留在里面。

senses.title: To put something inside an envelope
senses.definition: to include something inside a letter or package
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放入信件或包裹中一起寄出
senses.example: Please enclose a copy of your passport.
senses.exampleCN: 请随信附上护照复印件。
senses.why: A letter is a container in transit, so putting a document inside is a form of enclosing.
senses.whyCN: 信件是运输中的容器，因此把文件放进去就是一种封入。

senses.title: To contain or seal something in
senses.definition: to shut something inside a container or space
senses.definitionCN: 把某物关在容器或空间内部
senses.example: The seeds are enclosed in a hard shell.
senses.exampleCN: 种子被封在坚硬的壳里。
senses.why: The core idea is being inside a boundary, whether fence, envelope, or shell.
senses.whyCN: 核心概念是被边界包在里面，无论是栅栏、信封还是外壳。

intro.en: Enclose comes from Old French enclore, built on the Latin root claudere, to shut.

items.en: Claudere means to shut or close.

items.en: Enclore means to shut in or surround.

items.en: The spelling enclose becomes standard.

items.en: The word covers fences, envelopes, and sealed spaces.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词涵盖栅栏、信封和封闭空间。

note.en: Enclose surrounds or seals in; surround is wider, and attach means adding something to a message.
note.cn: enclose 围住或封入，surround 范围更广，attach 指把某物附加到消息中。

normalIntro.en: Enclose means to put something inside a boundary, an envelope, or a shell.
normalIntro.cn: enclose 意为把某物放入边界、信封或外壳之中。

normal.en: Please enclose your photo.

root: 古法语 enclore，建立在拉丁语 claudere（关闭）的词根上。

sensesIntro.en: The word covers boundaries, items sent in letters, and spaces sealed by shells or walls.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词涵盖边界、随信附上的物品，以及被外壳或墙壁封闭的空间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fence making a safe circle on open ground.
core.cn: 核心意象：栅栏在空地上围出安全的圆圈。

branches.en: The base sense is surrounding an area with a boundary.
branches.cn: 基本义是用边界围住一片区域。

branches.en: A letter becomes a container for an enclosed item.
branches.cn: 信件成为所附物品的容器。

branches.en: Any boundary that seals something inside fits the image.
branches.cn: 任何把东西封在里面的边界都符合这一意象。

branches.en: Fences and shells both keep an inside apart.
branches.cn: 栅栏与外壳都把内部隔开。

branches.en: The envelope and the shell are both enclosures.

latinIntro.en: The root claudere, to shut, also appears in include and exclude.
latinIntro.cn: 意为关闭的词根 claudere 也出现在 include 与 exclude 中。

enclosing 标记正在进行的动作。

definition_zh: 围住；圈占；（被围的）场地、围场；随信附件；圈地运动；（机器）外壳；（生态）围隔实验设施
definition_en: the act of surrounding an area with a fence or wall; an enclosed area of land; something enclosed with a letter or package; the historical conversion of common land into private fields; a casing that surrounds machinery; (ecology) an experimental pen or cage used to isolate a plot
core_image: 一圈栅栏把一块地围起来：里面和外面从此属于不同的规则
scene: 信纸里夹着一张照片，收信人抽出时看到了它。A photograph is folded inside the letter, and the reader pulls out this enclosure.
sceneCN: 这里 enclosure 是「随信附件」（第 3 个义项：与信件一起封入的东西）；句意：信纸里夹着一张照片，收信人把它抽了出来，这就是随信附件。图中可辨识物件：信封、信纸、夹在其中的照片、收信人的手。

pos.zh: 围住；圈占；围场；附件；外壳；圈地

senses.title: The act of surrounding an area
senses.definition: the act of putting a fence, wall, or barrier around an area
senses.definitionCN: 用篱笆、墙或屏障把一片区域围起来的动作
senses.example: The enclosure of the garden took a week of fencing work.
senses.exampleCN: 把花园围起来花了一周的栅栏活。
senses.why: Enclosure is enclose + -ure. Enclose is en- 'in' + close, and close goes back through Old French to Latin claudere 'to shut'. The suffix -ure names the act or its result, so the word can mean either the fencing or the fenced space.
senses.whyCN: enclosure 是 enclose + -ure。enclose 由 en-“在内”+ close 构成，close 经古法语上溯拉丁语 claudere“关闭”。后缀 -ure 命名行为或其结果，所以这个词既可指“围”的动作，也可指“被围的空间”。

senses.title: An enclosed area of land
senses.definition: a piece of land surrounded by a fence or wall, often used for animals or cultivation
senses.definitionCN: 被篱笆或墙围住的一块地，常用于养动物或耕种
senses.example: The sheep were moved to a smaller enclosure near the barn.
senses.exampleCN: 羊群被赶到谷仓附近一个较小的围场里。
senses.why: The result sense of -ure is at work here: the action of enclosing leaves behind a bounded place. English uses 'enclosure' for pens and paddocks more readily than 'pen', which is smaller and more specific.
senses.whyCN: 这里起作用的是 -ure 的结果义：围的动作留下一个有边界的地方。英语用 enclosure 指围场、牧区，比更小更具体的 pen 更常用。

senses.title: Something enclosed with a letter
senses.definition: an item placed inside an envelope or package along with a letter
senses.definitionCN: 与信件一起放入信封或包裹中的物品
senses.example: Please return the signed form and its enclosure by Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 请在周五前寄回签署的表格及其附件。
senses.why: The physical action becomes a postal convention: whatever is shut inside the envelope is an enclosure. Modern email replaced it with 'attachment', and the older word now sounds formal or legal.
senses.whyCN: 物理动作变成邮政惯例：被封进信封里的东西就是 enclosure。现代电子邮件用 attachment 取代了它，旧词如今显得正式或法律化。

senses.title: The historical enclosure of common land
senses.definition: the conversion of common or open land into privately owned fenced fields, especially in England
senses.definitionCN: 把公地或开放土地转为私有围圈田地，尤指英国
senses.example: The enclosure movement displaced many rural families in the eighteenth century.
senses.exampleCN: 18 世纪的圈地运动使许多农村家庭流离失所。
senses.why: History gives the word a heavy social charge: the fence is a legal act that excludes people from land they once used. 'Enclosure movement' is a fixed historical term, and the noun carries dispossession, not just fencing.
senses.whyCN: 历史给这个词沉重的社会含义：栅栏是一种法律行为，把人排除在他们曾使用的土地之外。enclosure movement 是固定历史术语，这个名词承载的是剥夺，而不只是围栏。

senses.title: A casing around machinery
senses.definition: a protective cover or housing that surrounds a machine or its parts
senses.definitionCN: 包围机器或其部件的保护性罩壳
senses.example: The motor's enclosure keeps dust out of the bearings.
senses.exampleCN: 马达的外壳防止灰尘进入轴承。
senses.why: Engineering uses the same 'shut in' structure: the enclosure is the boundary that protects what is inside. Here the purpose flips from excluding people to excluding dust, water, or noise.
senses.whyCN: 工程学沿用同样的“关在里面”结构：外壳是保护内部之物的边界。这里目的从“排除人”转为“排除灰尘、水或噪声”。

senses.title: A pen for farm animals
senses.definition: a fenced structure in which livestock are kept
senses.definitionCN: 用来圈养牲畜的围栏结构
senses.example: The pigs had a shaded enclosure with a wallow at one end.
senses.exampleCN: 猪有一个带遮阴的围栏，一端还有泥浴池。
senses.why: Animal husbandry narrows the land sense to a managed structure with a purpose: feeding, breeding, or protection. The word becomes countable, and 'enclosure' can be temporary or movable.
senses.whyCN: 畜牧用法把土地义收窄为有目的的管理结构：饲喂、繁殖或保护。这个词变得可数，围栏也可以是临时或可移动的。

senses.title: An experimental cage in ecology
senses.titleCN: 生态学中的围隔实验设施
senses.definition: a small fenced or caged plot used to isolate organisms under controlled conditions
senses.definitionCN: 用于在受控条件下隔离生物的小型围圈或网笼样地
senses.example: The researchers compared grazed and ungrazed plots using paired enclosures.
senses.exampleCN: 研究者用成对的围隔样地比较放牧与不放牧的地块。
senses.why: Field ecology turns the enclosure into an instrument: it keeps some things in and others out so that a difference can be measured. The noun here names a treatment, not a possession.
senses.whyCN: 野外生态学把围栏变成仪器：把某些东西留在里面、把另一些挡在外面，从而测量差异。这里这个名词命名的是一种处理，而非占有。

senses.title: A barrier that defines inside and outside
senses.definition: the fence, wall, or hedge itself, considered as the boundary between inside and outside
senses.definitionCN: 作为内外边界的篱笆、墙或树篱本身
senses.example: A high stone enclosure separated the monastery from the road.
senses.exampleCN: 一道高高的石围墙把修道院与道路隔开。
senses.why: This sense focuses on the boundary rather than the space it contains. It is the clearest expression of the claudere root: the barrier does not hold anything, it simply decides what is shut out.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项聚焦边界本身，而非它围住的空间。它最清楚地体现 claudere 词根：屏障并不装东西，它只决定什么被关在外面。

intro.en: Enclosure is enclose + -ure. Enclose joins en- 'in' to close, and close descends through Old French clos from Latin claudere 'to shut'. The noun suffix -ure, from Latin -ura, names an act or its result, which is why one word covers both the fencing and the fenced space.
intro.cn: enclosure 是 enclose + -ure。enclose 把 en-“在内”加在 close 上，而 close 经古法语 clos 上溯拉丁语 claudere“关闭”。名词后缀 -ure 来自拉丁语 -ura，命名行为或其结果，所以一个词同时覆盖“围”的动作与“被围的空间”。

items.en: Latin claudere meant 'to shut, close, block'. Its past participle clausus produced clausura 'a closing, a enclosed place', the source of English closure and the model for -ure nouns.
items.cn: 拉丁语 claudere 意为“关闭、合上、阻塞”。其过去分词 clausus 产生 clausura“关闭、封闭之处”，是英语 closure 的来源，也是 -ure 名词的模板。

items.en: Old French clos 'enclosed, shut' came from clausus. The verb enclore and the noun enclosure developed in French with the sense of shutting something within boundaries.
items.cn: 古法语 clos“被围的、关闭的”来自 clausus。动词 enclore 与名词 enclosure 在法语中发展出“把某物关在边界内”的意思。

items.en: English enclosure is recorded in the fifteenth century for the act of enclosing and for an enclosed place. The variant inclosure was common in earlier modern English and survives in some legal usage.
items.cn: 英语 enclosure 于 15 世纪被记录，指围住的行为与被围的地方。变体 inclosure 在早期现代英语中常见，并在某些法律用法中留存。

items.en: Enclosure became a legal and economic term for converting common fields into private ones. The great English enclosure movement peaked in the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
items.cn: enclosure 成为把公田转为私田的法律与经济术语。英国大规模圈地运动在 18 世纪至 19 世纪初达到高峰。

items.en: Engineering adopted enclosure for protective housings, and ecology for experimental pens. In both, the word keeps its literal function: a boundary that controls what crosses it.
items.cn: 工程学采用 enclosure 指防护外壳，生态学指实验围隔。两者都保留字面功能：控制什么可以越过的边界。

items.en: Email largely replaced the postal sense with attachment, but legal and formal writing still uses enclosure for documents sent with a letter, often abbreviated 'encl.'
items.cn: 电子邮件在很大程度上用 attachment 取代了邮政义，但法律与正式写作仍用 enclosure 指随信文件，常缩写为 encl.。

note.en: The first group separates same-root words built on claudere from one another; the second group separates kinds of bounded space and enclosed item.
note.cn: 第一组区分建立在 claudere 上的同源词；第二组区分各类有界空间与被封入之物。

entries.definition: the act of closing or the state of being closed, from Latin clausura. It names the shutting, not the fenced plot.
entries.definitionCN: 关闭的动作或状态，源自拉丁语 clausura。它命名“关上”，而非被围的地块。

entries.definition: to reveal what was hidden. Dis- 'un-' + claudere 'shut' means to un-shut, the exact opposite of enclosing.
entries.definitionCN: 揭示隐藏之物。dis-“解除”+ claudere“关闭”意为“打开”，与 enclosing 正好相反。

entries.definition: to contain as part of a whole. In- + claudere gives 'shut in', which is close to enclose but usually figurative: members of a set, not land.
entries.definitionCN: 作为整体的一部分包含。in- + claudere 给出“关在里面”，与 enclose 接近，但通常抽象：集合的成员，而非土地。

entries.definition: a small fenced area for animals. It is more specific and usually smaller than an enclosure.
entries.definitionCN: 圈养动物的小围栏。它比 enclosure 更具体，通常也更小。

entries.definition: an area with buildings enclosed by a wall. It stresses the buildings inside rather than the boundary.
entries.definitionCN: 由围墙围起的一片建筑区域。它强调里面的建筑，而非边界。

entries.definition: a file or item sent with a message. It is the modern replacement for the postal sense of enclosure.
entries.definitionCN: 随消息发送的文件或物品。它是 enclosure 邮政义的现代替代词。

normalIntro.en: Real associations: en- + close, Latin claudere, the -ure result suffix, and the fixed historical phrase enclosure movement.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联想：en- + close、拉丁语 claudere、表结果的 -ure 后缀，以及固定历史说法 enclosure movement。

normal.en: en- 'in' + close: enclose means 'shut in', and -ure makes it either the shutting or the shut-in place.
normal.cn: en-“在内”+ close：enclose 意为“关进去”，-ure 使它既可指“关”的动作，也可指“被关住的地方”。

normal.en: Latin claudere also gives closure and disclose — one shuts, the other un-shuts.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 claudere 还给出 closure 与 disclose——一个关上，一个打开。

normal.en: In a letter, the enclosure is whatever is shut inside the envelope with the note.
normal.cn: 在信件里，enclosure 就是和便条一起被封进信封的东西。

normal.en: An enclosure movement is not about fences as scenery; it is about who is allowed to use land.
normal.cn: 圈地运动不是关于栅栏风景，而是关于谁被允许使用土地。

normal.en: An ecological enclosure is a controlled 'inside' used to measure what happens outside it.
normal.cn: 生态围隔是一个受控的“内部”，用来测量外部发生的事。

abstract.en: Every enclosure draws two worlds and a rule for crossing between them.
abstract.cn: 每一道围合都划出两个世界，以及一条穿越其间的规则。

abstract.en: A boundary that keeps animals in also keeps something else out; protection and exclusion are the same wall seen from two sides.
abstract.cn: 把动物关住的边界同时也把别的东西挡在外面；保护与排斥是同一堵墙的两面。

abstract.en: What is enclosed becomes legible: a measured plot, a counted flock, a listed attachment.
abstract.cn: 被围起来的东西变得可读：一块可测量的地、一群可计数的羊、一份列出的附件。

examples.en: The enclosure of the wetland prevented further damage to the nesting birds.
examples.cn: 对湿地的围护防止了巢鸟受到进一步干扰。

examples.en: The eighteenth-century enclosure movement changed patterns of land ownership across England.
examples.cn: 18 世纪的圈地运动改变了英格兰的土地所有权格局。

examples.en: Please sign the letter and return it with its enclosures.
examples.cn: 请在信上签字，并连同附件一并寄回。

dict_mnemonic.text: “en 克漏，惹”——把漏洞围起来，惹得外人进不去 → enclosure 围场、围住

root: en-（在内）+ close（关闭，经古法语 clos 源自拉丁语 claudere“关闭”）+ -ure（行为／结果名词后缀）；字面义“关在里面”，核心是“用边界分出内外”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of enclosure all draw a boundary: around land, around animals, around a letter's contents, around a machine, around an experimental plot. Sometimes the word names the act, sometimes the bounded space, sometimes the barrier itself — the -ure suffix permits all three.
sensesIntro.cn: enclosure 的八个义项都画出一条边界：围住土地、围住动物、围住信件内容、围住机器、围住实验样地。这个词有时命名动作，有时命名有界空间，有时命名屏障本身——-ure 后缀允许这三种读法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fence line that separates an inside with one rule from an outside with another.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条栅栏线，把一种规则的“内”与另一种规则的“外”分开。

branches.en: THE ACT AND THE LINE: enclosing is the raising of a barrier, and the barrier itself is the boundary between in and out.
branches.cn: 动作与界线：围合是竖起屏障，而屏障本身就是内外边界。

branches.en: LAND AND LIVESTOCK: a bounded field or pen turns open space into a managed, countable unit.
branches.cn: 土地与牲畜：有界的田地或围栏把开放空间变成可管理的、可计数的单位。

branches.en: PROTECTED INSIDE: a letter's contents and a machine's parts are shut in so that they stay together and stay clean.
branches.cn: 受保护的内部：信件内容与机器部件被关在里面，以保持完整与清洁。

branches.en: HISTORY: the fence becomes a legal exclusion, turning shared use into private right.
branches.cn: 历史：栅栏变成法律排斥，把共用转为私有权利。

branches.en: SCIENCE: a controlled enclosure isolates a plot so that a difference can be measured.
branches.cn: 科学：受控围隔隔离出一块样地，使差异可被测量。

intro.en: Enclosure is a transparent -ure noun on the verb enclose, which itself is en- + close from Latin claudere. The affix set shows the verb, participles, the -ure noun, and same-root words with different prefixes.
intro.cn: enclosure 是在动词 enclose 上的透明 -ure 名词，而 enclose 本身是 en- + close，源自拉丁语 claudere。词缀组展示动词、分词、-ure 名词，以及不同前缀的同源词。

latinIntro.en: Latin claudere 'to shut' yields clausus, clausura, and the French family clos / enclore / enclosure. English also built disclose and include on the same root with different prefixes.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 claudere“关闭”产生 clausus、clausura，以及法语词族 clos / enclore / enclosure。英语也在同一词根上用不同前缀造出 disclose 与 include。

items.meaningCN: 围住；围场（-ure 表行为或结果）
items.exampleCN: 这个围场养了十二只羊。

items.meaning: to surround or shut something in
items.example: Please enclose a copy of your ID.

items.meaningCN: 被围住的；随附的（-ed 分词）

items.meaningCN: 围合的；包围的（-ing 分词形容词）
items.example: An enclosing wall kept the wind out.
items.exampleCN: 一道围墙把风挡在外面。

items.meaning: the act of closing or a shutting down
items.meaningCN: 关闭；停业（同源不同构词）
items.example: The closure of the factory cost many jobs.

items.meaning: to shut in, contain as part of a whole

items.example: He avoids lifts because of claustrophobia.

senses.title: To carry as genetic instruction

senses.definitionCN: （动词）把一段经历固定在记忆或文化形式中

intro.en: Encode is en- plus code, from Latin codex, a block of wood and then a book of laws; to encode is to put a thing into the written form that carries it.
intro.cn: encode 由 en- 加 code 组成，code 来自拉丁语 codex（一块木头，后指法典）；encode 就是把东西放进承载它的书写形式里。

items.en: Codex means a tree trunk or a block of wood, then a set of wax tablets.
items.cn: codex 意为树干、木块，后指一组蜡板。

items.en: Codex comes to mean a book of laws written on leaves.
items.cn: codex 转而指写在册页上的法典。

items.en: English uses code for a system of signals standing for words.
items.cn: 英语用 code 指代表词语的信号系统。

items.en: Telegraphy and computing form encode from en- plus code.
items.cn: 电报与计算机由 en- 加 code 造出 encode。

items.en: Biology uses encode for DNA carrying the instruction for a protein.
items.cn: 生物学用 encode 指 DNA 携带合成蛋白质的指令。

items.en: Psychology uses encode for the first fixing of an experience.
items.cn: 心理学用 encode 指一段经历的最初固定。

note.en: Encode, code and decode share Latin codex, a book of written leaves; encrypt is near in meaning but stresses hiding rather than converting.
note.cn: encode、code 与 decode 共享拉丁语 codex（册页之书）；encrypt 意思接近，但强调藏起来而不是转换形式。

dict_mnemonic.text: encode ＝ en-（使进入）＋ code（代码，拉丁 codex「木块 → 蜡板 → 法典」）＝「写进代码里」。名词 code 代码、法典，动词 decode 解码，名词 decoder 解码器，动词 codify 编纂。三类用法：信息 encode a message 把电文编码、encode data 编码数据、encode in binary 用二进制编码；基因 encode a protein 编码一种蛋白质、genetically encoded 由基因编码的；记忆 the brain encodes the smell 大脑把气味编码存下。名词 encoding 指编码这件事或编码方式，它同时也是现在分词。反义 decode 解码；近义 encrypt 侧重加密隐藏，transcribe 侧重转写成另一种形式。

root: en-（使进入）＋ code（代码，拉丁 codex：木块 → 蜡板 → 法典）→ encode（写入代码）

definition_zh: 包含；涵盖；包围；围绕
definition_en: to surround something, or to include it as part of a larger whole
core_image: 一道圆墙从四面合拢，把散落的房屋、井与树全部圈进墙内
scene: 课程说明列出的主题从语法、阅读一直排到学术写作，几乎没有遗漏。The course encompasses grammar, reading and academic writing.
sceneCN: 这里指课程把多个主题全部纳入范围（第 3 个义项：涵盖某一学科或主题范围）；句意：这门课程涵盖语法、阅读与学术写作。

senses.title: To surround on all sides
senses.definition: to encircle a place or an object so that it is enclosed on every side
senses.definitionCN: 把某个地方或物体从四面包起来，使其被围在中间
senses.example: High walls encompass the old courtyard.
senses.exampleCN: 高墙把这座旧庭院四面围住。
senses.why: The word begins with a picture of walking a full circle around something, which is physical enclosure.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初描绘的是绕某物走满一圈，也就是物理上的围合。

senses.title: To include as parts of a whole
senses.titleCN: 作为整体的一部分包含
senses.definition: to have a number of things inside a larger group or system
senses.definitionCN: 在一个更大的群体或系统内部容纳若干事物
senses.example: The collection encompasses works from three centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这批藏品包含三个世纪的作品。
senses.why: Once a circle is drawn, everything inside it is included, so enclosure becomes inclusion.
senses.whyCN: 圆圈一旦画定，圈内的一切便都被纳入，围合由此变成包含。

senses.title: To cover a subject or field
senses.definition: of a course, a book or a survey, to deal with a whole field of material
senses.definitionCN: 指课程、书籍或综述处理整片材料领域
senses.example: The course encompasses grammar, reading and academic writing.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程涵盖语法、阅读与学术写作。
senses.why: A syllabus is a boundary, and whatever falls inside its line is what the course covers.
senses.whyCN: 教学大纲就是一条边界，落在界线之内的一切就是课程涵盖的内容。

senses.title: To contain the members of a category
senses.definition: in logic, of a class or a term, to have certain members within its scope
senses.definitionCN: 在逻辑中，指某个类别或术语把某些成员纳入其范围
senses.example: The category encompasses both birds and bats.
senses.exampleCN: 这个类别既包括鸟类，也包括蝙蝠。
senses.why: A category is a circle in logic diagrams, and what it encompasses is what lies inside the circle.
senses.whyCN: 在逻辑图里类别就是一个圆，它所包含的就是圆内的东西。

senses.title: To enclose a piece of land
senses.definition: of a fence, a wall or a boundary, to shut in a piece of land
senses.definitionCN: 指篱笆、围墙或边界把一片土地围起来
senses.example: The new park encompasses the old orchard and the pond.
senses.exampleCN: 新公园把旧果园与池塘都圈了进去。
senses.why: Land is the most literal object of the verb, since a boundary drawn on the ground can be walked.
senses.whyCN: 土地是这个动词最字面的宾语，因为画在地上的界线可以真的走一圈。

senses.title: Of a policy that embraces goals
senses.definition: of a plan or a policy, to take in several aims or values as one programme
senses.definitionCN: 指计划或政策把若干目标或价值纳入同一套方案
senses.example: The reform encompasses both housing and transport.
senses.exampleCN: 这项改革把住房与交通都纳入其中。
senses.why: A policy, like a wall, draws a line around what it will deal with, and that line is its scope.
senses.whyCN: 政策像围墙一样，为它要处理的事画出界线，这条界线就是它的范围。

senses.title: To go around something (old sense)
senses.definition: in older usage, to travel all the way around a place
senses.definitionCN: 在较早用法中，指绕某地走完一整圈
senses.example: The old text describes a pilgrim who encompassed the shrine.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇旧文描述一位绕行圣殿一周的朝圣者。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the walk itself, before the word became a matter of scope.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项就是走这一圈本身，后来这个词才转向范围问题。

senses.title: To cover every case or possibility
senses.definition: to take in all relevant cases so that none is left outside
senses.definitionCN: 把所有相关情形都纳入，不留下任何一个在外面
senses.example: The rules are written to encompass every likely dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 这些规则的写法要涵盖所有可能出现的纠纷。
senses.why: Completeness is a circle with no gap in it, which is why the word can mean covering everything.
senses.whyCN: 完整就是一个没有缺口的圆，因此这个词可以表示涵盖一切。

intro.en: Encompass is an English verb built from a prefix meaning in and a noun for a circuit or a circle. The noun came from Latin by way of French, and the verb has meant both to surround and to include since the fourteenth century.
intro.cn: 本词是英语动词，由表示「进入」的前缀与表示一周、一圈的名词构成。那个名词经法语来自拉丁语，这个动词自十四世纪起就兼指环绕与包含。

items.en: Passus meant a step, and it stands behind English words for pace and for the measured stride.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词指一步，英语中表示步幅与步测的词都出自它。

items.en: The verb meant to measure out by steps, and so to go around a space with a measured stride.
items.cn: 这个拉丁动词意为用步子量出，因此指以等长的步幅绕一片空间走一圈。

items.en: Old French took the word for a circuit, a circle and the instrument that draws one.
items.cn: 古法语用这个词指一周、一圈，也指画圆的器具。

items.en: English borrowed the noun as a circuit or a boundary, and kept the tool sense for the magnetic compass.
items.cn: 英语借入这个名词，指一周或一条边界，并保留了指磁性罗盘的工具义。

items.en: The verb, recorded from the fourteenth century, first meant to go around and then to shut in.
items.cn: 这个动词自十四世纪有记载，先指绕行，后指围在里面。

items.en: Modern usage made inclusion the dominant sense, so a course or a policy encompasses its material.
items.cn: 现代用法让「包含」成为主导义，因此课程或政策会把其内容涵盖在内。

note.en: The first group shares the circuit noun or looks close to it; the second group names nearby kinds of inclusion and enclosure. Encompass stresses that everything lies inside one boundary, while include only says that something is among the parts.
note.cn: 第一组共享表示一圈的名词或字形相近；第二组是相邻的包含与围合类型。本词强调一切都在同一条界线之内，包含类词只说某物在组成部分之中。

abstract.en: Picture a rope laid on the ground in a single closed circle.
abstract.cn: 想象一根绳在地上摆成一个闭合的圆。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence that can hold every example you can think of inside its grammar.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话，它的语法装得下你能想到的所有例子。

abstract.en: Picture a net thrown over a whole orchard, branches and fruit together.
abstract.cn: 想象一张网罩住整片果园，枝与果一并罩住。

examples.en: The reserve encompasses three lakes and a stretch of forest.
examples.cn: 保护区包含三个湖泊和一片森林。

examples.en: Her report encompasses both the causes and the remedies.
examples.cn: 她的报告既涵盖原因，也涵盖补救办法。

examples.en: The old walls encompass the entire village.
examples.cn: 旧城墙把整个村庄围在里面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「恩」加「康帕斯」——拿圆规在地上画一整圈，把东西全圈进来：包含、包围

root: 拉丁语「步」衍生出「用步子量一圈」的动词，经古法语指一周、一圈及画圆之器，十四世纪进入英语；由环绕转指包含。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one circle: physical enclosure, inclusion in a whole, a field covered, a category's members, a walled piece of land, a policy's aims, an old walk around and completeness.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一个圆：物理围合、作为整体的一部分、被涵盖的领域、类别的成员、圈起的土地、政策的目标、古义的绕行与完整无缺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round wall closing from every side, taking in the scattered houses, the well and the trees.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道圆墙从四面合拢，把散落的房屋、井与树全部圈进墙内。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL RING: a place surrounded, and a park walled around an orchard and a pond.
branches.cn: 物理圆环：被围住的地方，以及把果园与池塘圈进墙内的公园。

branches.en: THE MEMBERS: works inside a collection, and members inside a logical category.
branches.cn: 成员：藏品中的作品，以及逻辑类别中的成员。

branches.en: THE SCOPE: a course covering a field, and a policy taking in several aims.
branches.cn: 范围：涵盖某一领域的课程，以及纳入多项目标的政策。

branches.en: THE OLD WALK: a pilgrim travelling all the way around a shrine.
branches.cn: 古义的绕行：朝圣者绕圣殿走完一整圈。

branches.en: THE COMPLETE CIRCLE: every case taken in, with no gap left in the line.
branches.cn: 完整之圆：所有情形都被纳入，界线没有缺口。

definition_zh: 遇到；遭遇；邂逅
definition_en: to meet someone or face something unexpectedly
core_image: 转过林间小路，突然与一只鹿面对面
scene: 我们在森林里遇到一只鹿。We encountered a deer in the forest.
sceneCN: 这里 encounter 是「遇到」（第 1 个义项：意外遇见某人或某物）；句意：我们在森林里遇到一只鹿。

senses.title: To meet someone or something
senses.definition: to meet a person, animal, or thing, especially by chance
senses.definitionCN: 尤其指偶然遇见某人、动物或事物
senses.example: We encountered a deer in the forest.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在森林里遇到一只鹿。
senses.why: The word is built on a Latin phrase for coming face to face, so it stresses the meeting itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个词建立在拉丁语「面对面」的说法上，因此强调相遇本身。

senses.title: To face a difficulty
senses.definition: to experience or come up against a problem, danger, or opposition
senses.definitionCN: 经历或直面问题、危险或反对
senses.example: The team encountered several problems.
senses.exampleCN: 团队遇到了几个问题。
senses.why: A difficulty stands in one's path like a person, so meeting it becomes encountering it.
senses.whyCN: 困难像人一样挡在路上，因此与它相遇就变成遭遇它。

senses.title: A meeting or confrontation
senses.definition: an unexpected meeting or a short conflict between people
senses.definitionCN: 意外的会面或人与人之间短暂的交锋
senses.example: Their first encounter was brief.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的初次相遇很短暂。
senses.why: The verb becomes a noun naming the event of coming face to face.
senses.whyCN: 动词转化为名词，命名面对面相遇的事件。

definition_zh: 鼓励；支持；促进
definition_en: to give someone confidence or support to do something, or to help something grow
core_image: 老师拍拍学生的肩，让他再试一次
scene: 老师鼓励我们大胆提问。Our teacher encourages us to ask questions.
sceneCN: 这里 encourage 是「鼓励」（第 1 个义项：给某人信心或支持去做某事）；句意：老师鼓励我们大胆提问。

senses.title: To give someone confidence
senses.definition: to give a person support, hope, or confidence to do something

senses.example: Our teacher encourages us to ask questions.
senses.exampleCN: 老师鼓励我们大胆提问。
senses.why: The word contains courage, so encouraging is putting heart into someone.
senses.whyCN: 这个词含有 courage，因此鼓励就是把勇气放进别人心里。

senses.title: To help something develop
senses.definition: to make an activity, condition, or growth more likely
senses.definitionCN: 使某项活动、状况或增长更有可能发生
senses.example: Warm weather encourages plant growth.
senses.exampleCN: 温暖的天气促进植物生长。
senses.why: Support can be given to processes as well as people, so the word also means fostering.
senses.whyCN: 支持不仅能给人，也能给过程，因此这个词也指培育促进。

senses.title: To urge or recommend
senses.definition: to suggest strongly that someone should do something
senses.definitionCN: 强烈建议某人应该做某事
senses.example: Doctors encourage regular exercise.
senses.exampleCN: 医生提倡规律运动。
senses.why: Encouragement often includes advice, so the word can carry a gentle push toward action.
senses.whyCN: 鼓励常包含建议，因此这个词也带有温和推动行动的意味。

examples.cn: 篱笆每年往小路上多占一点。

examples.en: New cameras encroach on the privacy of the people below.
examples.cn: 新装的摄像头侵犯了楼下住户的隐私。

examples.en: Meetings began to encroach on the hours set aside for writing.
examples.cn: 会议开始侵占原本留给写作的时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: encroach ＝ en-（使进入）＋ croch（钩子，古法语 croc）＝「用钩子一点点拉过来」→ 侵占、蚕食。名词 encroachment 侵占、侵害，同根 crook 钩状杖、骗子，crochet 钩针编织。三类用法：土地 encroach on land 侵占土地、encroach on territory 侵入领地；权利 encroach upon rights 侵害权利、encroach on privacy 侵犯隐私；时间 encroach on time 占用时间、encroach gradually 逐步蚕食。几乎总与 on 或 upon 连用，是不及物动词，不能说 encroach something。注意 encroach 强调渐进、每次一点点，trespass 强调一次越界，intrude 强调不请自来。

root: en-（使进入）＋ 古法语 croc（钩子）→ encrochier（钩住、抓取）→ encroach（一点点钩过来：侵占）

sensesIntro.en: Three slow takings: a fence moving inward each year, a lens angled through an open window and grey blocks filling the white squares of a calendar.

intro.en: Encyclopedia comes from Greek enkyklios paideia, general education, built from kyklos, a circle, and paideia, upbringing; the word names knowledge taken all the way round.
intro.cn: encyclopedia 来自希腊语 enkyklios paideia（全面的教育），由 kyklos（圆）与 paideia（教养）构成；这个词指的是绕成一整圈的知识。

items.en: Kyklos means a circle or a wheel, and gives cycle and cyclic.
items.cn: kyklos 意为圆、轮，给出 cycle 与 cyclic。

items.en: Paideia means upbringing or education, from pais, a child.
items.cn: paideia 意为教养、教育，来自 pais（孩子）。

items.en: The phrase means general education, the whole circle of learning.
items.cn: 这个短语意为全面的教育，即整圈的学问。

items.en: Latin writers take the phrase as a single word for a course of knowledge.
items.cn: 拉丁作者把这个短语当作一个词，指一套知识课程。

items.en: English uses encyclopedia for a work covering all branches of knowledge.
items.cn: 英语用 encyclopedia 指涵盖各科知识的著作。

items.en: The French Encyclopedie makes the word a symbol of the Enlightenment.
items.cn: 法国《百科全书》使这个词成为启蒙运动的象征。

note.en: Encyclopedia, encyclopedic and cycle share Greek kyklos, a circle; the paideia half gives pedagogy, and dictionary is a near neighbour of a different root.
note.cn: encyclopedia、encyclopedic 与 cycle 共享希腊语 kyklos（圆）；paideia 那一半给出 pedagogy，而 dictionary 是不同词根的邻居。

dict_mnemonic.text: encyclopedia ＝ en-（在内）＋ cyclo（圆，希腊 kyklos）＋ ped（教养，希腊 paideia）＋ -ia（名词后缀）＝「绕成一整圈的教养」→ 百科全书。形容词 encyclopedic 百科全书式的、渊博的，名词 encyclopedist 编纂者；同根 cycle 循环、cyclic 循环的、pedagogy 教育学。英式拼写常作 encyclopaedia，复数 encyclopedias。三类用法：纸本 consult an encyclopedia 查阅百科全书、an encyclopedia entry 百科条目；网络 an online encyclopedia 在线百科、edit an encyclopedia 编辑百科；比喻 a walking encyclopedia 活百科、the encyclopedia of music 音乐大全。注意与 dictionary 不同：dictionary 按词排，encyclopedia 按知识条目排。

root: 希腊语 en-（在内）＋ kyklos（圆）＋ paideia（教养）→ enkyklios paideia（全面教育）→ encyclopedia（百科全书）

definition_zh: vt. 危及；使遭到危险；危害
definition_en: to put someone or something in a situation where harm or loss is possible
core_image: 堤坝上出现一道细缝，巡坝人把标记旗插下去，下游村庄的灯还亮着
scene: 巡坝人在细缝旁插下标记旗，下游村庄的灯还亮着。The crack could endanger the village downstream.
sceneCN: 这里 endanger 指「危及」（第 1 个义项：使某人或某物处于可能受害的境地）；句意是这道裂缝可能危及下游的村庄。

intro.en: Endanger is en- plus danger, from Old French dangier, power or lordship, from Latin dominium; to endanger is to put a thing under a power that can harm it.
intro.cn: endanger 由 en- 加 danger 组成，danger 来自古法语 dangier（权力、支配），源自拉丁语 dominium；endanger 就是把东西置于一种能伤害它的力量之下。

items.en: Dominium means ownership or lordship, from dominus, a master.
items.cn: dominium 意为所有权、支配权，来自 dominus（主人）。

items.en: Dangier means power to harm or the reach of a lord.
items.cn: dangier 意为伤害的权力、领主势力所及。

items.en: English danger first means power or jurisdiction, then peril.
items.cn: 英语 danger 最初指权力、管辖，后指危险。

items.en: English forms endanger from en- plus danger, to put in peril.
items.cn: 英语由 en- 加 danger 造出 endanger，意为置于危险中。

items.en: The participle endangered is used of species at risk of dying out.
items.cn: 分词 endangered 用于指有灭绝风险的物种。

items.en: Law uses endangerment for conduct that creates a risk of harm.
items.cn: 法律用 endangerment 指造成损害风险的行为。

note.en: Endanger, danger and dangerous share Old French dangier, power to harm; threaten and jeopardize are near in meaning but carry no idea of lordship.
note.cn: endanger、danger 与 dangerous 共享古法语 dangier（伤害的权力）；threaten 与 jeopardize 意思接近，却不带支配权的意味。

dict_mnemonic.text: endanger ＝ en-（使进入）＋ danger（危险，古法语 dangier「支配权」，拉丁 dominium）＝「使进入危险之中」。名词 danger 危险，形容词 dangerous 危险的，名词 endangerment 危及、危害，副词 dangerously 危险地。三类用法：安全 endanger lives 危及生命、endanger health 危害健康、endanger the public 危及公众；物种 endanger the species 危及物种，分词 endangered species 濒危物种；风险 endanger national security 危及国家安全、endanger the witnesses 危及证人。注意 endanger 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不加 to；dangerous 才是形容词。词源上 danger 原指领主的支配权，落在谁手里谁就危险。

root: en-（使进入）＋ 拉丁语 dominium（支配权）→ 古法语 dangier → danger（危险）→ endanger（使陷入危险）

intro.en: Endearment is endear plus -ment; endear is en- plus dear, from Old English deore, precious; an endearment is the thing that makes someone dear to you.

root: en-（使）＋ 古英语 deore（珍贵的）→ dear（亲爱的）→ endear（使受喜爱）→ endearment（爱称；亲昵举动）

intro.en: Endeavour is en- plus devoir, duty, from Old French deveir and Latin debere, to owe; to endeavour is to put yourself under a duty to do the thing.
intro.cn: endeavour 由 en- 加 devoir（职责）组成，devoir 来自古法语 deveir 与拉丁语 debere（欠）；endeavour 就是让自己背负起做这件事的责任。

items.en: Debere means to owe, and gives debt, debit and due.
items.cn: debere 意为欠，给出 debt、debit 与 due。

items.en: Deveir means duty or what one ought to do.
items.cn: deveir 意为职责、应当做的事。

items.en: American spelling drops the u, giving endeavor.

note.en: Endeavour comes from Latin debere, to owe, through French devoir, duty; debt, due and duty are cousins, while effort and attempt are the nearest synonyms.

intro.en: Endocrine is Greek endon, within, plus krinein, to separate; an endocrine gland separates its product inward, into the tissue and blood, instead of sending it out through a duct.
intro.cn: endocrine 由希腊语 endon（在内）加 krinein（分开、筛选）构成；内分泌腺把产物向内分离、送进组织与血液，而不是经导管排到体外。

items.en: Endon is a Greek preposition meaning within or inside.
items.cn: endon 是希腊语介词，意为在内、在内部。

items.en: Krinein is Greek for to separate, and gives crisis and critic.
items.cn: krinein 在希腊语中意为分开、判断，给出 crisis 与 critic。

items.en: Endokrinos describes glands that separate inward and have no duct.
items.cn: endokrinos 形容向内分离、没有导管的腺体。

items.en: The adjective enters scientific English in the 19th century.
items.cn: 这一形容词在 19 世纪进入科技英语。

items.en: The ending -crine names modes of secretion, as in exocrine.
items.cn: 词尾 -crine 用来表示分泌方式，如 exocrine。

items.en: Endocrinology becomes the medical study of hormone glands.
items.cn: endocrinology 成为研究激素腺体的医学分支。

note.en: Endocrine uses the Greek combining form -crine, from krinein to separate; exocrine, autocrine and paracrine name other ways a gland releases its product, and endocrinology is the study of the whole system.
note.cn: endocrine 用了希腊构词成分 -crine（源自 krinein，分开）；exocrine、autocrine 与 paracrine 指明腺体排出产物的其他方式，endocrinology 则是对整套系统的研究。

dict_mnemonic.text: endocrine ＝ endo-（在内，希腊 endon）＋ -crine（分开，希腊 krinein）＝「把产物向内分开」。腺体不经导管排出，而是直接送进血液，所以叫内分泌。名词 endocrinology 内分泌学，人物 endocrinologist 内分泌科医生。同一词尾还能造 exocrine 外分泌的、autocrine 自分泌的、paracrine 旁分泌的。常见搭配：the endocrine system 内分泌系统、an endocrine gland 内分泌腺、endocrine disorder 内分泌失调。记住 krinein 也给了 crisis 与 critic，都是「分开、判断」。

intro.en: Endorse is en- plus Latin dorsum, the back; to endorse is literally to write on the back of a document, and the sense of public approval grew out of that signature on the reverse.
intro.cn: endorse 由 en- 加拉丁语 dorsum（背）构成，字面义就是在文件背面写字；公开支持这一含义正是从背面的那行签名引申而来。

items.en: Dorsum is the Latin word for the back.
items.cn: dorsum 是拉丁语中的背部一词。

items.en: Old French dos, back, comes down from dorsum.
items.cn: 古法语 dos 意为背部，由 dorsum 而来。

items.en: Dorsare means to write on the back of a document.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 dorsare 意为在文件背面书写。

items.en: Endorse enters English for signing on the reverse.
items.cn: 16 世纪 endorse 进入英语，指在背面签名。

items.en: The older spelling indorse stays in law and banking.
items.cn: 旧拼写 indorse 保留在法律与银行业务中。

items.en: To endorse becomes standard language for backing a candidate.
items.cn: endorse 成为支持候选人的标准竞选用语。

note.en: Endorse, dorsal and dossier all go back to Latin dorsum, the back; endorsement is the noun of the act, and indorse is the older spelling still met on cheques.
note.cn: endorse、dorsal 与 dossier 都可追到拉丁语 dorsum（背）；endorsement 是该行为的名词，indorse 是票据上仍能见到的旧拼法。

entries.definition: of or on the back

normalIntro.en: En- makes, and dorsum is the back: write on the back
normalIntro.cn: en- 表示使…，dorsum 是背：写在背面

normal.en: A signature on the back of a cheque is an endorsement
normal.cn: 在支票背面签下名字，就是背书

normal.en: Endorse and dorsal share Latin dorsum, the back
normal.cn: endorse 与 dorsal 共用拉丁语 dorsum（背）

normal.en: To back someone publicly is to put your name behind them

normal.en: Indorse is the older spelling of the very same act

normal.en: Endorsement names whatever endorse has done

abstract.en: A famous name printed in large letters under a candidate poster
abstract.cn: 候选人海报下方用大字印着一位名人名字

abstract.en: A rubber stamp coming down on the last page of a report
abstract.cn: 报告最后一页上盖下的橡皮图章

abstract.en: A pen turning a cheque over to write on its blank back
abstract.cn: 一支笔把支票翻过来，在空白的背面写字

examples.en: The former minister chose to endorse the younger candidate.
examples.cn: 那位前任部长选择支持更年轻的候选人。

examples.en: She endorsed the cheque before handing it over.
examples.cn: 她在支票背面签好字才递过去。

examples.en: The party endorsed the report after a long debate.
examples.cn: 经过长时间讨论，该党认可了这份报告。

dict_mnemonic.text: endorse ＝ en-（使…）＋ dors（背，拉丁 dorsum）＋ -e ＝「写在背面」。先在背面签名，再由签名推出「支持、认可」。名词 endorsement 支持与背书，受款人 endorsee 是被背书的一方。三个用法：公开支持 endorse a candidate、正式认可 formally endorse a report、票据背书 endorse a cheque。旧拼法 indorse 仍常见于法律与银行文本。同根还有 dorsal 背部的、dossier 案卷，都出自 dorsum。

root: 拉丁语 dorsum（背部）→ 古法语 dos（背）→ endorse（在背面签名；支持）

sensesIntro.en: Four uses: public support, official approval, a signature on the back, and a cost charged to an account
sensesIntro.cn: 四种用法：公开支持、正式认可、背面签名，以及把费用记入账户

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pen turning a cheque over to write on its blank back

branches.en: A name put behind a candidate.

branches.en: Both bind the writer to the paper.

branches.en: Both turn approval into a written act.
branches.cn: 两者都把认可写成一笔记录。

intro.en: Endorse is en- plus dors plus a final e; -ment makes the noun endorsement, and the older in- gives the variant indorse.
intro.cn: endorse 由 en- 加 dors 再加词尾 e 构成；-ment 构成名词 endorsement，旧的 in- 则给出异体 indorse。

latinIntro.en: Latin dorsum is the back, and from it come dorsal, dossier and the Medieval Latin verb dorsare, to write on the back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dorsum 指背部，dorsal、dossier 与表示「在背面书写」的中世纪拉丁动词 dorsare 都由它而来。

definition_zh: 忍受；忍耐；持续
definition_en: to suffer something difficult patiently, or to continue to exist for a long time
core_image: 暴风雪里，一棵老树弯下腰却没有折断
scene: 她忍受了漫长而寒冷的冬天。She endured the long, cold winter.
sceneCN: 这里 endure 是「忍受」（第 1 个义项：耐心承受痛苦或困难）；句意：她忍受了漫长而寒冷的冬天。

senses.title: To bear something difficult
senses.definition: to suffer pain, hardship, or an unpleasant situation patiently
senses.definitionCN: 耐心承受疼痛、艰苦或不愉快的处境
senses.example: She endured the long, cold winter.
senses.exampleCN: 她忍受了漫长而寒冷的冬天。
senses.why: The Latin root means to harden, so enduring is standing firm under pressure.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为变硬，因此忍受就是在压力下站稳。

senses.title: To last or continue
senses.definition: to continue to exist or remain strong over time
senses.definitionCN: 随着时间继续存在或保持稳固
senses.example: The old bridge has endured for centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老桥已经屹立了几个世纪。
senses.why: What hardens against wear can also last, so the word shifts from bearing to surviving.
senses.whyCN: 能抗住磨损的事物也能长久存在，因此词义从承受转向存续。

intro.en: Endure comes from Latin indurare, to harden, through Old French endurer.
intro.cn: endure 来自拉丁语 indurare（使变硬），经古法语 endurer 进入英语。

items.en: Indurare means to make hard or to last.
items.cn: indurare 意为使变硬、持续。

items.en: Endurer means to bear or suffer.
items.cn: endurer 意为承受、忍受。

items.en: English borrows endure with both bearing and lasting senses.
items.cn: 英语借入 endure，兼具忍受与持续两义。

items.en: Endure becomes common for pain, hardship, and time.
items.cn: 在近代早期，endure 常用于疼痛、艰苦与时间。

items.en: The word still joins patient suffering with lasting strength.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词仍把耐心承受与持久力量结合在一起。

note.en: Endure bears pain over time; tolerate is more neutral, and last stresses continuing to exist.
note.cn: endure 长期承受痛苦，tolerate 更中性，last 强调继续存在。

entries.definition: the power to bear pain or effort for long
able to last a long time without damage
the length of time something lasts
to accept something painful
to accept something unpleasant without protest
to continue to exist

normalIntro.en: Endure is to harden yourself under pain and to keep standing over time.
normalIntro.cn: endure 是在痛苦中让自己变硬，并随时间继续站立。

normal.en: She endured the cold winter.
normal.cn: 她忍受了寒冷冬天。

normal.en: The bridge has endured for centuries.
normal.cn: 这座桥屹立了几个世纪。

normal.en: Endurance is the ability to endure.
normal.cn: endurance 是忍受的能力。

normal.en: Enduring value lasts a long time.
normal.cn: enduring value 持续很久。

normal.en: Some pain is hard to endure.
normal.cn: 有些痛苦难以忍受。

abstract.en: Picture an old tree bending in a storm.
abstract.cn: 想象老树在暴风雪中弯腰。

abstract.en: See a stone bridge worn smooth by time.
abstract.cn: 想象被时间磨得光滑的石桥。

abstract.en: Think of a rope holding under heavy weight.
abstract.cn: 想象绳子在重压下坚持。

examples.en: Some pain is hard to endure.
examples.cn: 有些痛苦难以忍受。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因丢尔」——再苦也不肯「丢」下自己；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 indurare（使变硬），经古法语 endurer 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: The word covers bearing hardship patiently and continuing to exist over time.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词涵盖耐心承受艰苦，以及随时间继续存在。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old tree bending but not breaking in a storm.

branches.en: The base sense is bearing pain or hardship.

branches.en: What bears wear also continues to exist.

branches.en: Patience and durability grow from the same hardness.

branches.en: The -ance noun names the strength to bear.

branches.en: Enduring things outlast their makers.

intro.en: Endure is built on the Latin root dur, meaning hard or lasting.
intro.cn: endure 建立在拉丁词根 dur 上，意为坚硬、持久。

latinIntro.en: Durare, to last, also gives durable and duration.
latinIntro.cn: durare（持续）也构成 durable 与 duration。

definition_zh: adj. 精力充沛的；充满活力的；用力做的
definition_en: having or showing a great amount of energy, or done with a lot of force and effort
core_image: 终场哨响之前，全队还在回追拦截，别人都已弯腰撑膝，只有她仍能冲刺
scene: 训练课上没人坐下休息，教练一直喊到最后一组。The whole squad stayed energetic until the final whistle.
sceneCN: 这里 energetic 指「精力充沛的」（第 1 个义项：体力充沛、不觉疲倦）；句意是全队直到终场哨响仍保持充沛精力。

pos.zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的；积极的

senses.title: A tireless body
senses.definition: having lots of physical energy and never seeming tired
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）有充沛体力，看上去从不疲倦
senses.example: The whole squad stayed energetic until the final whistle.
senses.exampleCN: 全队直到终场哨响仍精力充沛。
senses.why: A player sprinting back to defend after already scoring twice
senses.whyCN: 已经进了两球却还回追防守的球员

senses.title: Done with force

senses.example: The MPs made an energetic protest against the closure.
senses.exampleCN: 议员们对关停方案发起了有力的抗议。
senses.why: A hand banging the desk in time with every sentence
senses.whyCN: 每说一句话就跟着拍一下桌子的另一只手

senses.title: A hands-on person
senses.definition: acting quickly and eagerly, with plenty of initiative
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）行动又快又主动，很有干劲

senses.why: A diagram of particles flying out of a coil
senses.whyCN: 示意图上从线圈里飞出去的一串粒子

intro.en: Energetic comes from Greek energeia, being at work, built from en plus ergon, work; the word first described something actually working, not merely able to work.
intro.cn: energetic 来自希腊语 energeia（正在活动），由 en 加 ergon（工作）构成；它最初形容正在起作用的事物，而不只是有能力起作用。

items.en: Ergon is Greek for work, and gives energy.
items.cn: ergon 在希腊语中意为工作，给出 energy。

items.en: Energeia means being active, actually at work.
items.cn: energeia 意为处于活动、正在工作的状态。

items.en: Energetikos describes action or speech at work.
items.cn: energetikos 形容正在起作用的行动或言语。

items.en: Energetic enters English in medical and philosophical writing.
items.cn: 16 世纪 energetic 进入英语，用于医学与哲学著作。

items.en: The word moves into everyday praise of a lively person.
items.cn: 该词进入日常用法，称赞人活泼而有干劲。

items.en: Physics keeps it for states carrying energy.
items.cn: 物理学保留它表示带有能量的状态。

note.en: Energetic, energy and synergy all rest on Greek ergon, work; energetically is the adverb, energize is the verb, and anergic is the negated mirror.
note.cn: energetic、energy 与 synergy 都落在希腊语 ergon（工作）上；energetically 是副词，energize 是动词，anergic 是否定形式构成的反面镜像。

normal.en: En- plus ergon: the state of being at work

normal.en: More energetic, most energetic: the scale of one effort

normal.en: Anergic is the mirror image, with the energy gone

normal.en: Synergy is many people at work together

abstract.en: A hand banging the desk in time with every sentence
abstract.cn: 每说一句话就跟着拍一下桌子的另一只手

abstract.en: A manager already on the phone before the meeting ends
abstract.cn: 会议还没散场就已经在打电话的经理

examples.en: The whole squad stayed energetic until the final whistle.
examples.cn: 全队直到终场哨响仍精力充沛。

examples.en: She gave an energetic talk that ran well over time.

examples.en: Nothing is more energetic than this class on sports day.
examples.cn: 运动会那天，没有哪个班比这个班更有活力。

dict_mnemonic.text: energetic ＝ en-（在内）＋ erg（工作，希腊 ergon）＋ -etic（形容词后缀）＝「内部正在做功」。名词 energy 精力与能量，动词 energize 激励或供电，副词 energetically 精力充沛地。四个用法：身体不知疲倦 an energetic child、行动有力 an energetic debate、人干练 an energetic manager、物理术语 energetic particles。同一词根还有 synergy 协同效应。拼写注意中间是 -er-，不要漏掉 e。

root: 希腊语 en（在内）＋ ergon（工作）→ energeia（活动）→ energetic（精力充沛的）

sensesIntro.en: Four uses: a tireless body, a forceful action, a hands-on manager, and a physics term
sensesIntro.cn: 四种用法：不知疲倦的身体、有力的行动、干练的管理者，以及一个物理学术语

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body still working after everyone else has sat down

branches.en: A body that will not sit down.
branches.cn: 一副不肯坐下休息的身体。

branches.en: An action done with full force.

branches.en: A person who starts before being asked.

branches.en: Both show effort you can see.

branches.en: Both name a system running at power.

intro.en: Energetic is en- plus erg plus -etic; -y makes the adjective ending, -ize makes a verb, and -ally makes the adverb.
intro.cn: energetic 由 en- 加 erg 再加 -etic 构成；-y 组成形容词结尾，-ize 变成动词，-ally 变成副词。

latinIntro.en: Greek ergon means work, and gives energy, ergometer and synergy; energeia is the state of being at work.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 ergon 意为工作，给出 energy、ergometer 与 synergy；energeia 则指正在工作的状态。

core_image: 一根笔直的木柱被长年雨水泡软，慢慢向内弯下；一个人从站着说话变成要扶着桌沿才说得下去
scene: 病房记录本上写着，长期卧床让腿部肌肉一点点退化。Years in bed gradually enfeebled every muscle in his legs.
sceneCN: 这里 enfeeble 指「使…衰弱」（第 1 个义项：使身体失去力气）；句意是长年卧床使他腿部每一块肌肉逐渐衰弱。

senses.title: To weaken a body
senses.definition: to make a person physically weaker
senses.definitionCN: （动词）使一个人的身体变得更弱
senses.example: Years in bed gradually enfeebled every muscle in his legs.

senses.why: A man who used to stand to speak now holding the edge of the table
senses.whyCN: 过去站着讲话的人，如今说话时要扶住桌沿

senses.title: To weaken a system
senses.definition: to make an institution or process less effective
senses.definitionCN: （动词）使某一制度或过程失去效力
senses.example: Three reforms were meant to enfeeble the old committee.
senses.exampleCN: 三项改革意在削弱那个旧的委员会。
senses.why: A channel narrowed year by year until the current slackens
senses.whyCN: 河道一年年变窄，水流随之变缓

senses.title: To weaken a case
senses.definition: to reduce the force of an argument or an effect
senses.definitionCN: （动词）减弱论点或效果的力度
senses.example: One counterexample enfeebled the whole theory.
senses.exampleCN: 一个反例就削弱了整套理论。
senses.why: A single number written in pencil under a confident graph
senses.whyCN: 在一幅自信的图表下方用铅笔写上的一个数字

intro.en: Enfeeble is en- plus feeble; feeble reached English through Old French from Latin flebilis, lamentable, so to enfeeble is to reduce something to a state worth mourning.
intro.cn: enfeeble 由 en- 加 feeble 构成；feeble 经古法语来自拉丁语 flebilis（令人哀叹的），所以 enfeeble 就是把事物削弱到令人叹息的地步。

items.en: Flebilis means lamentable, fit to be wept over.
items.cn: flebilis 意为令人哀叹、值得哭泣的。

items.en: Fieble means weak, and is the form English took.
items.cn: 古法语 fieble 意为虚弱，是英语采用的形式。

items.en: The adjective feeble is in English before the verb.
items.cn: 形容词 feeble 比动词更早出现在英语中。

items.en: Middle English enfeeblen adds en- to make a verb.
items.cn: 中古英语 enfeeblen 给形容词加上 en- 构成动词。

items.en: The modern spelling settles as enfeeble.
items.cn: 现代拼写定为 enfeeble。

items.en: Doctors use it for organs worn down by long illness.
items.cn: 医生用它形容被久病损耗的器官。

note.en: Enfeeble, feeble and enfeeblement share one adjective; debilitate and sap carry the same idea from Latin roots, while feeble alone only describes the state.
note.cn: enfeeble、feeble 与 enfeeblement 共用同一个形容词；debilitate 与 sap 从拉丁词根表达相同的意思，而 feeble 单用只描述那种状态。

of or having a fever

to weaken something slowly and steadily

normalIntro.en: En- makes, feeble is weak: to make weak
normalIntro.cn: en- 表示使…，feeble 是弱：使变弱

normal.en: Add en- to feeble and an adjective turns into a verb
normal.cn: 给 feeble 加上 en-，形容词就变成了动词

normal.en: Enfeeblement is the noun of the same process
normal.cn: enfeeblement 是同一过程的名词

normal.en: Two e in the middle: not enfeble
normal.cn: 中间双写 e，不是 enfeble

normal.en: A post softened by rain slowly bends inward
normal.cn: 被雨水泡软的木柱慢慢向内弯折

normal.en: Enervate and enfeeble both begin by taking strength away
normal.cn: enervate 与 enfeeble 都从夺走力气开始

abstract.en: A man who used to stand to speak now holding the edge of the table
abstract.cn: 过去站着讲话的人，如今说话时要扶住桌沿

abstract.en: A channel narrowed year by year until the current slackens
abstract.cn: 河道一年年变窄，水流随之变缓

abstract.en: A single number written in pencil under a confident graph
abstract.cn: 在一幅自信的图表下方用铅笔写上的一个数字

examples.en: Years in bed gradually enfeebled every muscle in his legs.
examples.cn: 长年卧床使他腿上的每一块肌肉逐渐衰弱。

examples.en: The long war enfeebled the small country.
examples.cn: 这场旷日持久的战争削弱了这个小国。

examples.en: A fair counterexample enfeebles any tidy argument.
examples.cn: 一个公允的反例就能削弱任何看似整齐的论点。

dict_mnemonic.text: enfeeble ＝ en-（使…）＋ feeble（虚弱的）＝「使变弱」。en- 把形容词 feeble 变成及物动词，同类构词有 enrich 使丰富、enslave 使为奴。名词 enfeeblement 衰弱与削弱，副词 feebly 虚弱地，抽象名词 feebleness 虚弱。三个用法：使身体衰弱 enfeeble the body、削弱体系 enfeeble the immune system、削弱论点 enfeeble an argument。拼写中间是双 e，别写成 enfeble。

root: en-（使…）＋ 古法语 fieble（虚弱）→ 拉丁语 flebilis（令人哀叹的）→ enfeeble（使衰弱）

sensesIntro.en: Three ways of taking strength away: a body, an institution, and an argument
sensesIntro.cn: 三种夺走力量的方式：身体、制度与论点

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight post softened by rain slowly bending inward
core.cn: 核心意象：一根笔直的木柱被雨水泡软，慢慢向内弯折

branches.en: Muscle gives way after long rest.
branches.cn: 久卧之后，肌肉先失去力气。

branches.en: A committee loses its grip.
branches.cn: 一个委员会失去掌控力。

branches.en: An argument loses its force.
branches.cn: 一个论点失去说服力。

branches.en: Both wear down from the inside.
branches.cn: 两者都从内部慢慢耗尽。

branches.en: Both are weakened by one small change.
branches.cn: 两者都可能被一个小改动削弱。

intro.en: Enfeeble is en- plus feeble plus a final e; -ment makes the noun enfeeblement, and -ness makes feebleness from the adjective alone.
intro.cn: enfeeble 由 en- 加 feeble 再加词尾 e 构成；-ment 构成名词 enfeeblement，-ness 则直接从形容词构成 feebleness。

latinIntro.en: Feeble came from Latin flebilis, lamentable, which is from flere, to weep; the sense moved from worth weeping over to simply weak.
latinIntro.cn: feeble 来自拉丁语 flebilis（令人哀叹的），flebilis 又出自 flere（哭泣）；词义从「值得哭泣」转为单纯的虚弱。
